names.summary: The exported name, table ownership, callers, and sibling source agree on decathlon score calculation.
The signed-short contract and stream-fade visibility are authenticated; a semantic function name is not.
Initializer chronology and helper boundaries are recovered, but the user-facing behavior has not been named from sufficient evidence.
Control flow and signed return behavior are exact; semantic naming remains open.
Assigned through Hu3DLayerHookSet by three target consumers and implements the GX texture-copy source, destination, and copy sequence for the stage capture buffer.
Installed by Hu3DModelMatHookSet in fn_1_2D850 and configures the captured, indirect-warp, and blend texture stages for the stage model.
Passed as the object callback to omAddObjEx, allocates the capture texture and animations, creates the stage model, installs the material hook, and binds its work record.
Used as the owning OMOBJMAN argument for every authenticated stage-texture omAddObjEx creation path.
Stores the stage-texture OMOBJ returned by creation and is consumed by the model, effect-start, cleanup, and destroy paths.
Loaded by HuSprAnimRead, bound to GX_TEXMAP2, and selected as the authenticated indirect-texture input for the stage material hook.
Loaded by HuSprAnimRead, bound to GX_TEXMAP3, and consumed by the final authenticated texture-combine stage in the material hook.
Allocated to the exact GX RGB565 copy-buffer size, written by GXCopyTex, sampled by the material hook, and freed by the stage-texture cleanup path.
Target extent 0x50 and all consumers authenticate two 0x28 stage-texture work records covering the indirect matrix, color, offset, step, and remaining-time fields.
